brand.name: DYD Creative Solutions
brand.description: DYD brings together AI, software, mobile, design and creative expertise to build smarter solutions and meaningful experiences.

services.title: AI & Intelligent Solutions
services.headline: AI that works with your business.
services.intro: Move beyond AI experimentation. We design, build and integrate intelligent solutions that understand business knowledge, connect with existing systems and support meaningful business processes.
services.short: Make AI work for your business.
sections: Intelligence, grounded in your knowledge.
Connect documents, websites, knowledge bases, structured content and enterprise data. Equip specialized agents with the knowledge, instructions and skills to support your customers and teams.
Connected to the way you work.
Integrate AI with applications, databases, cloud services, CMS, LMS and CRM platforms. MCP, APIs and custom tools let authorized agents interact with external systems and support business actions.

services.title: Application Development
services.headline: Technology built for the way you work.
services.intro: Off-the-shelf software doesn’t solve every problem. DYD designs, develops and integrates custom applications around the unique requirements of organizations and their users.
sections: From idea to implementation.
Strategy, architecture, UX/UI, development, integration, deployment and support. We bring the disciplines together so decisions made at the beginning hold up in the finished solution.
Part of your ecosystem.
Build around the systems your organization already uses. Connect platforms, data and business processes through considered architecture and integration.

services.title: Mobile Solutions
services.headline: Powerful experiences in people’s hands.
services.intro: Mobile is more than another screen. We design and develop mobile experiences that connect people with information, services and organizations wherever they are.
sections: Designed for real life.
UX, development, integration and analytics work together to create useful experiences across iOS and Android. We choose mobile frameworks around the needs of the experience.
Connected mobile experiences.
Bring enterprise systems, cloud platforms, APIs, content, learning, AI services and authentication into one considered mobile experience.

services.title: Learning Technology
services.headline: Technology that transforms how people learn.
services.intro: Learning experiences are becoming more connected, personalized and intelligent. We design and build digital learning ecosystems that connect people, content, platforms and data.
sections: An ecosystem for learning.
Connect content, platforms and learner experiences. Integrate learning portals, assessments, mobile learning and enterprise training with the systems that support them.
Intelligent learning.
Bring intelligent assistants, knowledge agents, assessments and conversational experiences into digital learning environments. Use learning analytics to understand and improve the experience.

services.title: Graphic Design & Branding
services.headline: Design that communicates.
services.intro: From individual campaigns to complete visual systems, we help organizations communicate ideas through thoughtful, consistent and engaging design.
services.short: Give your ideas a distinctive voice.
sections: Visual storytelling.
Complex ideas become more powerful when people can understand them. Visual thinking, storytelling and brand strategy turn communication into something clear and memorable.
Consistency with character.
Connect the everyday details with the big picture. From presentations and campaign creative to print and digital assets, every expression should belong to the same brand.

services.title: Digital Experience
services.headline: Digital experiences designed around people.
services.intro: Technology works best when people don’t have to think about the technology. We combine UX, UI, content and development to create experiences that feel intuitive, engaging and useful.
sections: Design + technology.
Creative and technical teams work together from the beginning. Connect design, content, implementation, performance and accessibility around the people using the experience.
From first impression to next step.
Consider the complete journey, from how people find you to what they need to do next. Content and interaction work together to make the experience understandable.

services.title: Events & Experiences
services.headline: Bring your brand to life.
services.intro: Events create opportunities to connect with people. We develop cohesive experiences from concept and visual direction through the materials and digital experiences that support them.
sections: One cohesive experience.
From the invitation to the stage to the digital follow-up, every touchpoint should feel connected. Create a consistent visual and digital experience throughout the event journey.
Beyond the screen.
Bring conferences, exhibitions, live events, presentations and physical environments together under one creative vision.

caseStudyModel.publicationRule: Only approved project content. No invented clients or metrics.
